Dynamic Topic Management

TaktX is designed to create Kafka topics dynamically as new job workers, user tasks, or process types are introduced. This dynamic approach supports rapid growth and changing workloads, and is a key enabler for horizontal scalability and operational flexibility.

Automatic Topic Creation (When Permitted)

The engine can automatically create topics on demand, but this depends on the permissions granted by the Kafka operator. In some environments—especially in smaller teams or development setups—Kafka clusters are configured to allow applications to create topics as needed. In these cases, TaktX will detect new workloads and create the necessary topics with the appropriate configuration (such as partition count and retention policy) automatically.

Enterprise Considerations: Restricted Permissions

In larger enterprises, however, Kafka operators often restrict topic creation permissions for security, governance, and operational reasons. It is common for production Kafka clusters to disallow applications from creating topics directly. In these environments, topic management becomes a collaborative process between application teams and Kafka operators.

Planned Administration Application

To address this, we are planning a dedicated administration application. This tool will help Kafka operators and application teams manage TaktX topics more effectively. The administration app will:

  • Allow operators to review, approve, and create topics manually when automatic creation is not permitted.
  • Optionally, allow controlled topic creation by the administration application when permissions are granted.
  • Provide visibility into existing topics, their configuration, and usage.
  • Support lifecycle management, including topic deletion and reconfiguration.

This approach ensures that TaktX can be deployed flexibly in both permissive and tightly controlled Kafka environments, supporting both rapid development and enterprise-grade governance.

Operational Flexibility

By supporting both automatic and operator-driven topic management, TaktX adapts to a wide range of operational requirements. This enables continuous delivery and rapid iteration in development, while ensuring compliance and control in production.
